SELECT c.comment_id, c.tenant_id, c.owner_type, c.owner_id, c.parent_comment_id, c.content, c.comment_type, c.event_type, c.writer_id, c.writer_name, c.last_modified_by, c.last_modified_by_name, c.deleted_yn, c.created_at, c.updated_at,
FROM tb_common_comment c
WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.owner_type = 'APPROVAL' AND c.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND c.comment_type = 'SYSTEM' AND c.deleted_yn = 'N' ORDER BY c.created_at ASC, c.comment_id ASC

SELECT c.comment_id, c.tenant_id, c.owner_type, c.owner_id, c.parent_comment_id, c.content, c.comment_type, c.event_type, c.writer_id, c.writer_name, c.last_modified_by, c.last_modified_by_name, c.deleted_yn, c.created_at, c.updated_at,
FROM tb_common_comment c
WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.owner_type = #{ownerType} AND c.owner_id IN
#{ownerId}
AND c.comment_type = 'SYSTEM' AND c.deleted_yn = 'N' ORDER BY c.owner_id, c.created_at ASC, c.comment_id ASC

WITH RECURSIVE all_comment_tree AS ( SELECT c.comment_id, c.parent_comment_id, c.deleted_yn, c.comment_id AS root_comment_id FROM tb_common_comment c WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.owner_type = #{ownerType} AND c.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND c.parent_comment_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT child.comment_id, child.parent_comment_id, child.deleted_yn, tree.root_comment_id FROM tb_common_comment child JOIN all_comment_tree tree ON tree.comment_id = child.parent_comment_id WHERE child.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND child.owner_type = #{ownerType} AND child.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND child.comment_id <> ALL(ARRAY[tree.comment_id]) ), root_page AS ( SELECT root_comment_id AS comment_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY root_comment_id DESC) AS root_order FROM all_comment_tree GROUP BY root_comment_id HAVING BOOL_OR(deleted_yn = 'N')
AND root_comment_id < #{beforeCommentId}
ORDER BY root_comment_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} ), comment_tree AS ( SELECT c.comment_id, c.tenant_id, c.owner_type, c.owner_id, c.parent_comment_id, c.content, c.comment_type, c.event_type, c.writer_id, c.writer_name, c.last_modified_by, c.last_modified_by_name, c.deleted_yn, c.created_at, c.updated_at, rp.root_order, ARRAY[c.comment_id] AS comment_path FROM tb_common_comment c JOIN root_page rp ON rp.comment_id = c.comment_id UNION ALL SELECT child.comment_id, child.tenant_id, child.owner_type, child.owner_id, child.parent_comment_id, child.content, child.comment_type, child.event_type, child.writer_id, child.writer_name, child.last_modified_by, child.last_modified_by_name, child.deleted_yn, child.created_at, child.updated_at, tree.root_order, tree.comment_path || child.comment_id FROM tb_common_comment child JOIN comment_tree tree ON tree.comment_id = child.parent_comment_id WHERE child.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND child.owner_type = #{ownerType} AND child.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND NOT child.comment_id = ANY(tree.comment_path) ) SELECT c.comment_id, c.tenant_id, c.owner_type, c.owner_id, c.parent_comment_id, c.content, c.comment_type, c.event_type, c.writer_id, c.writer_name, c.last_modified_by, c.last_modified_by_name, c.deleted_yn, c.created_at, c.updated_at,
FROM comment_tree c
ORDER BY c.root_order, c.comment_path

WITH RECURSIVE all_comment_tree AS ( SELECT c.comment_id, c.parent_comment_id, c.deleted_yn, c.comment_id AS root_comment_id FROM tb_common_comment c WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.owner_type = 'APPROVAL' AND c.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND c.comment_type = 'USER' UNION ALL SELECT child.comment_id, child.parent_comment_id, child.deleted_yn, tree.root_comment_id FROM tb_common_comment child JOIN all_comment_tree tree ON tree.comment_id = child.parent_comment_id WHERE child.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND child.owner_type = 'APPROVAL' AND child.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND child.comment_type = 'USER' AND child.comment_id <> tree.comment_id ), root_page AS ( SELECT root_comment_id AS comment_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY root_comment_id DESC) AS root_order FROM all_comment_tree GROUP BY root_comment_id HAVING BOOL_OR(deleted_yn = 'N')
AND root_comment_id < #{beforeCommentId}
ORDER BY root_comment_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} ), comment_tree AS ( SELECT c.comment_id, c.tenant_id, c.owner_type, c.owner_id, c.parent_comment_id, c.content, c.comment_type, c.event_type, c.writer_id, c.writer_name, c.last_modified_by, c.last_modified_by_name, c.deleted_yn, c.created_at, c.updated_at, rp.root_order, ARRAY[c.comment_id] AS comment_path FROM tb_common_comment c JOIN root_page rp ON rp.comment_id = c.comment_id UNION ALL SELECT child.comment_id, child.tenant_id, child.owner_type, child.owner_id, child.parent_comment_id, child.content, child.comment_type, child.event_type, child.writer_id, child.writer_name, child.last_modified_by, child.last_modified_by_name, child.deleted_yn, child.created_at, child.updated_at, tree.root_order, tree.comment_path || child.comment_id FROM tb_common_comment child JOIN comment_tree tree ON tree.comment_id = child.parent_comment_id WHERE child.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND child.owner_type = 'APPROVAL' AND child.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND child.comment_type = 'USER' AND NOT child.comment_id = ANY(tree.comment_path) ) SELECT c.comment_id, c.tenant_id, c.owner_type, c.owner_id, c.parent_comment_id, c.content, c.comment_type, c.event_type, c.writer_id, c.writer_name, c.last_modified_by, c.last_modified_by_name, c.deleted_yn, c.created_at, c.updated_at,
FROM comment_tree c
ORDER BY c.root_order, c.comment_path

WITH RECURSIVE cursor_user_tree AS ( SELECT root.comment_id, root.deleted_yn, ARRAY[root.comment_id] AS comment_path FROM tb_common_comment root WHERE root.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND root.owner_type = 'APPROVAL' AND root.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND root.comment_id = #{commentId} AND root.comment_type = 'USER' AND root.parent_comment_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT child.comment_id, child.deleted_yn, tree.comment_path || child.comment_id FROM tb_common_comment child JOIN cursor_user_tree tree ON tree.comment_id = child.parent_comment_id WHERE child.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND child.owner_type = 'APPROVAL' AND child.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND child.comment_type = 'USER' AND NOT child.comment_id = ANY(tree.comment_path) ) SELECT cursor.comment_id, cursor.tenant_id, cursor.owner_type, cursor.owner_id, cursor.parent_comment_id, cursor.content, cursor.comment_type, cursor.event_type, cursor.writer_id, cursor.writer_name, cursor.last_modified_by, cursor.last_modified_by_name, cursor.deleted_yn, cursor.created_at, cursor.updated_at, CASE WHEN cursor.deleted_yn = 'N' THEN la.profile_image ELSE NULL END AS writer_profile_image FROM tb_common_comment cursor LEFT JOIN public.tb_login_account la ON la.tenant_id = cursor.tenant_id AND la.login_code = cursor.writer_id WHERE cursor.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND cursor.owner_type = 'APPROVAL' AND cursor.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND cursor.comment_id = #{commentId} AND cursor.parent_comment_id IS NULL AND ( (cursor.comment_type = 'SYSTEM' AND cursor.deleted_yn = 'N') OR ( cursor.comment_type = 'USER' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM cursor_user_tree GROUP BY cursor_user_tree.comment_id HAVING BOOL_OR(cursor_user_tree.deleted_yn = 'N') ) ) )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_common_comment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND owner_type = 'APPROVAL' AND owner_id = #{ownerId} AND comment_type = 'USER' AND parent_comment_id IS NULL AND deleted_yn = 'N'

SELECT c.comment_id, c.tenant_id, c.owner_type, c.owner_id, c.parent_comment_id, c.content, c.comment_type, c.event_type, c.writer_id, c.writer_name, c.last_modified_by, c.last_modified_by_name, c.deleted_yn, c.created_at, c.updated_at,
FROM tb_common_comment c
WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.comment_id = #{commentId} AND c.deleted_yn = 'N'

UPDATE tb_common_comment SET deleted_yn = 'Y', last_modified_by = #{actorId}, last_modified_by_name = #{actorName}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND comment_id = #{commentId} AND writer_id = #{actorId} AND comment_type = 'USER' AND COALESCE(UPPER(owner_type), '') <> 'APPROVAL' AND deleted_yn = 'N'
